harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored branch_orders on node1 with exact keys, relationships, and monetary values. node2 has persistent read-only reporting access via /root/.branch-report.cnf. MariaDB and all data recovered after sequential restarts of both nodes; the export, OS release, and kernel remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed CentOS Stream 10 AppStream MariaDB 10.11 server on node1 and client on node2.
Imported the supplied SQL export without modifying it.
Created branch_reporter, restricted it to node2, and granted SELECT only on customers and orders.
Enabled MariaDB at boot, bound it to node1's managed address, and restricted TCP/3306 through firewalld to node2.
Stored the generated reporting credential on node2 in a root-owned mode-600 client file.
Verified administrator writes, reporter reads, reporter write denial, exact data, foreign-key integrity, and export preservation.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Exact relational restore with supplied primary keys, monetary values, and customer/order relationships
evidence.summary: DDL proves both primary keys, DECIMAL(10,2), and the foreign key. Queries show IDs 10/20 and 101/102/103 with amounts 12.35, 99.90, and 0.05; orphan count is zero.

evidence.requirement: node2 reporting account can read but cannot modify data; administrator retains writes
evidence.summary: node2 reads both tables as branch_reporter; UPDATE and post-restart DELETE receive ERROR 1142. Root has ALL PRIVILEGES and successfully performs a transactional write probe.
Before and after SHA-256 is 1311c3635d31265b3dfa067fe371ac457e8bd6e7529374aa6f254e1777b48a37; size, mode, and timestamp remain unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained with compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64; MariaDB 10.11 comes from the native AppStream repository.

Healthy baseline boot fb2aa416-d036-46d3-aeb8-30c65a01cb34, acknowledged native reboot, changed boot 9d30467c-c66b-43e6-8b18-96870b139351, active MariaDB, intact data, zero orphans, and unchanged export.

Healthy baseline boot 32e1f4e0-0ae4-4b67-9b90-4ddc6c4ce51e, acknowledged native reboot, changed boot 4376da1a-b29a-436d-b6e4-051b72a42034, recovered mode-600 credentials, remote reads, exact values, and continuing write denial.
